title: API Data Collector
prompt: Design a bounded request workflow using a documented test endpoint or saved fixture. Work with synthetic data or explicitly authorized lab resources; document assumptions and verify output locally.
objective: Apply lessons around Using Invoke-RestMethod to demonstrate design a bounded request workflow using a documented test endpoint or saved fixture.

starter.code:
# TODO: API Data Collector

# Input: synthetic sample data or a reviewed local fixture.

expected_output: A reviewed PowerShell script for API Data Collector with clear structured output, documented assumptions, and a local validation note.
acceptance_criteria: Meets the prompt and reports a structured, understandable result.
Validates inputs and handles at least one edge or failure case.
Contains a repeatable manual or automated check and documents its limits.
Uses no secrets, real personal data, or unauthorized targets.
hints: Sketch the input and desired output before coding.
Separate data preparation from the action and report layers.
Test invalid and empty input using local fixtures before considering real data.
grading_method: Repository grader performs a required-string smoke check only; it does not execute PowerShell or establish runtime correctness. Use local pwsh, Pester where appropriate, and human review.
retry_policy: Allow retries; completion and XP remain subject to platform backend policy. This file defines no XP override.
status_note: Draft exercise adapted from Section C of PowerShell.pdf; review prompt, tests, and protected reference solution before publication.
